passages.text: The following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the federal securities laws and should be read in conjunction with the disclosures we make concerning risks and other factors that may affect our business and operating results. You should read this information in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and the notes thereto included in Part II, Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data , of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. See also “Forward-Looking Statements” immediately prior to Part I, Item 1, Business , of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Our Company We are a leading developer, manufacturer, and provider of data storage devices and solutions based on HDD technology. HDDs are critical components of the global data infrastructure market and play an essential role in enabling the AI-driven data economy. They provide reliable, cost-effective, high-capacity storage for a broad range of applications, including cloud data centers, enterprise storage systems, edge computing, smart video, client and consumer devices. Our broad portfolio of technology and products, sold under the Western Digital® and WD® brands, addresses our customers’ storage needs through multiple end markets: “Cloud,” “Client” and “Consumer”. Cloud is our largest and fastest growing end market comprised primarily of products for public or private cloud environments and enterprise customers. Through the Client end market, we provide our OEM and channel customers a broad array of high-performance HDD solutions across desktop and notebooks. The Consumer end market offers a comprehensive portfolio of HDD external storage products that we offer globally through our retail and channel partners. Our fiscal year ends on the Friday nearest to June 30 and typically consists of 52 weeks. Approximately every five to six years, we report a 53-week fiscal year to align the fiscal year with the foregoing policy. Fiscal year 2026, which ended on July 3, 2026, comprised 53 weeks, with the first quarter consisting of 14 weeks and the remaining quarters consisting of 13 weeks. Fiscal years 2025 and 2024, which ended on June 27, 2025 and June 28, 2024, respectively, each comprised 52 weeks, with all quarters presented consisting of 13 weeks. 32 Table of Contents Key Developments Market Conditions and Outlook The increasing long-term demand for data storage in the cloud is benefiting our HDD business. The adoption of AI and workloads driven by hybrid data are propelling growth in data storage as well. This creates an accelerated demand for higher-capacity drives, which have greater manufacturing complexity and longer production lead times. In response, customers are partnering with us earlier to support their future growth requirements and are extending the duration of their commercial arrangements, which improves our long-term visibility of demand. credit_strengths.text: Operating margin expanded sharply year over year and sits well above the sector median, reflecting pricing power and mix shift toward higher-capacity nearline drives sold into cloud and AI-driven data infrastructure demand. This earnings quality underpins cash generation and cushions the thin absolute debt base.

Gross leverage fell to a fraction of the prior year and sits far below the sector median, while net debt is negative after netting unrestricted cash. The indicative financial risk profile is Minimal on both leverage and cash-flow bases, leaving substantial headroom against typical covenant thresholds.

key_risks.text: Debt reduction was achieved largely through non-cash exchanges of retained Sandisk shares rather than operating cash, and those exchanges produced material charges. The remaining capital structure is concentrated in convertible notes whose holders retain conversion rights, so future share settlements could dilute equity and alter leverage independent of earnings.

A meaningful share of cash sits outside the United States, and the revolving facility matures in the near term with the convertible notes convertible through the coming quarter. Refinancing and repatriation flexibility therefore depend on lender appetite and tax consequences rather than on balance-sheet strength alone.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is far above the sector median and improved sharply year over year, with operating income dwarfing gross interest expense. Free cash flow covers debt many times over, so scheduled amortization and the near-term maturity are comfortably serviceable from internal resources.

Operating cash flow exceeds capital expenditure and shareholder distributions combined, and free cash flow alone covers dividends and buybacks. Buybacks absorb the bulk of distributions, so the cushion is real but sensitive to repurchase pace and to working-capital swings in a cyclical drive market.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer enters the coming year with minimal leverage, net cash, and coverage and cash-flow ratios well ahead of sector medians, supported by a structurally growing cloud and AI storage demand backdrop. Our view is that credit quality is strong and the principal sensitivity is capital allocation rather than debt service.

Analyst judgement: continued large buybacks funded from free cash flow would keep leverage low but reduce the buffer against a demand downturn, while conversion of the remaining notes would further shrink debt at the cost of dilution. We would monitor distribution policy and the near-term maturity closely.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率按年大幅擴張，並遠高於行業中位數，反映定價能力以及產品組合轉向容量更高的 nearline 硬碟，銷售至雲端及 AI 驅動的數據基礎設施需求。此盈利質素支撐現金產生，並為薄弱的絕對債務基礎提供緩衝。
總槓桿降至去年的一小部分，並遠低於行業中位數，而扣除未受限現金後淨債務為負。按槓桿及現金流基礎計算，指示性財務風險狀況均為極低，相對典型契約門檻留有充裕空間。

key_risks.text: 債務減少主要透過保留的 Sandisk 股份進行非現金交換實現，而非來自經營現金，且該等交換產生重大費用。剩餘資本結構集中於可換股票據，其持有人保留轉換權，因此未來的股份結算可能攤薄股權，並在盈利之外改變槓桿。
相當部分現金位於美國境外，循環融資額度於短期內到期，而可換股票據於未來一季內可轉換。因此再融資及資金回流靈活性取決於貸款人意願及稅務後果，而非僅取決於資產負債表實力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，並按年大幅改善，經營利潤遠超總利息支出。自由現金流覆蓋債務多倍，因此預定攤銷及短期到期可從內部資源輕鬆償付。
經營現金流超過資本支出與股東分派之和，而僅自由現金流已覆蓋股息及回購。回購吸收大部分分派，因此緩衝確實存在，但對回購步伐及周期性硬碟市場的營運資金波動敏感。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人進入來年時槓桿極低、淨現金，覆蓋率及現金流比率遠超行業中位數，並受結構性增長的雲端及 AI 存儲需求背景支撐。我們認為信用質素強勁，主要敏感因素在於資本配置而非債務償付。
分析師判斷：持續以自由現金流資助的大規模回購將保持低槓桿，但會減少抵禦需求下行的緩衝，而剩餘票據的轉換將進一步縮減債務，代價是攤薄。我們將密切監察分派政策及短期到期情況。
